review.instruction: Verify exactly one delivered receipt matches sourceRole, was emitted done by the corresponding backend or frontend generator, and binds the same frozen checkout head. Verification receipts remain evidence and never replace delivered-source provenance.

Verify every delivered fact claim cites role, path, line range and frozen source head; at least one fact exists; intent and examples are not treated as delivery; contradictions become discrepancies rather than published claims.

Verify every frozen coverage-matrix dimension has exactly one delivered-evidence row and every discrepancy is concrete. The report lists open unchecked coverage; any open journey coverage prevents implemented state. The published matrix itself is never edited.

Verify target is implemented or in-progress, prior head exists, lifecycle transition matches both states, feature and fingerprints agree, reconciliation has zero discrepancies, and the model is archived by content address and indexed under only this feature. A mismatch publishes no model.

failurePolicy: Record each exact delivery or matrix discrepancy and emit the complete reconciliation. Repair requires changed delivered source, evidence or requested state; do not rewrite the promise, matrix or goal, and never republish unchanged failing input.
